# Jade Nails & Spa

> A nail salon in Midlothian, Virginia offering manicures, pedicures, gel, acrylic, dip powder, nail art, and waxing.

## Contact

- Website: https://jadenailsva.com/
- Address: 6924 Woodlake Commons Loop, Midlothian, VA 23112
- Phone: (804) 639-8302
- Booking: https://www.lldtek.org/salon/appt/VmtGZk1UQXhNRFE9
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jadenailswoodlake/

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Price list

Prices marked "& up" vary by length, shape, or design. All services are final. Sanitation, disinfecting and sterilization are paramount: a dental-grade autoclave steam-sterilizes all metal instruments.
